text:
talia: bring-up brief for neptune-9b-int4 hybrid run. ran full smoke + GTN slices. want routing + scorecard recs for product.

evan: quick numbers please

talia: p50 38ms, p95 165ms (4k batching), throughput ~720 tok/s, est cost $0.0029 per 1k tokens vs int8 $0.0050
mohit: big cost delta (~42%) nice. quality?

talia: GTN 2k sample sweep: short QA/faq accuracy ~0.2% down, long-form summarization ROUGE-L -1.8, instruction-following measurable drop on multi-step tasks (~2.4% acc)
sara: 2.4% on multi-step might impact workflow editors and GTN flows. any concentrated slices?
talia: regressions concentrated on: multi-step code edits, long-chain math, and legal clause extraction. hallucination rate +1.3% on legal extracts
mohit: suggest hybrid routing: default int4 for chat & search snippets; train small flow classifier for high-assurance flows -> int8; code detection -> int8. Also route long-context (>1200) to int8
evan: what's detection budget? cheap ngram + regex ok?
mohit: we can start with heuristics (``` , def, class, contract, clause, invoice, balance) + context_len, then collect labels to refine a light distil classifier later
sara: product ask: need scorecard CSV for PM/GTN with business impact note and recommended pricing bucket. columns: slice, sample_n, metric, int8_value, int4_value, delta_abs, percent_delta, accept_threshold, route_rule, biz_risk
talia: adding monitoring flags: alert if hallucination delta > 1.5% or p95 > +12% vs int8. Ops: auto-fallback if fallback_reasons > 0.8% in 1h

alert-bot: baseline snapshots captured for neptune-9b-int4 vs neptune-9b-int8 at ts=3076543200
mohit: also flag token-ppl drift after 1024 tokens; int4 shows rising ppl slope -> cap at 1024 for now
evan: OPS tasks? feature flags, dashboards, fallback logic?
talia: yes. ops: create flag neptune-int4-canary, implement routing hooks, expose metrics: hallucination-rate, fallback-rate, latency by context_len, per-slice quality sampling. shadowing: enable 50% shadow rate for first week
sara: GTN messaging draft: "Cost-optimized tier for everyday content; fidelity tier recommended for legal/code/financial flows." include sample worst-case diffs and suggested guidance for customers
mohit: timeline proposal: today - scorecard CSV draft; ops - routing + flag by Fri; Mon start 10% live non-high-assurance canary + 50% shadow, review after 7 days -> expand to 40% if stable
evan: include small A/B on pricing to measure adoption sensitivity. also include rollback playbook steps
talia: I'll post the CSV and 1-pager in #eng-ml and attach redacted sample diffs. thanks all :raised_hands:
sara: +1. please include explicit list of slices to monitor in the dashboard so GTN can map to product owners

alert-bot: canary flag created: neptune-int4-canary. monitoring hooks registered.
